run_panda_simulation: run the pybullet panda robot simulation in GUI mode with inverse kinematics control
create_panda_sim_instance: create a PandaSim instance with a bullet client and position offset for the panda robot
configure_pybullet_visualizer: configure the pybullet debug visualizer to enable Y-axis up orientation
set_pybullet_physics: set the pybullet physics time step and gravity for the simulation environment
step_panda_ik_loop: step the panda robot simulation loop using inverse kinematics and joint motor control
